gbm_population_evidence.quote: Subjects with newly diagnosed pathologically verified GB.

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a single-arm, non-randomized, open-label Phase 2 therapeutic study that will assess the effects of adding BPM31510 onto a conventional treatment framework of RT and concurrent TMZ chemotherapy for subjects with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subjects with newly diagnosed pathologically verified GB.

role_evidence.quote: will assess the effects of adding BPM31510 onto a conventional treatment framework of RT and concurrent TMZ chemotherapy
Subjects will receive a weekly, 96-h infusion of BPM31510 for a duration of 8 weeks.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational intravenous coenzyme Q10 (ubidecarenone) formulation BPM31510; record excludes patients with CoQ10 allergy
arms: BPM31510, Vitamin K1, RT and TMZ

role_evidence.quote: Subjects will receive prophylactic Vitamin K1 at a recommended dose of 10 mg subcutaneously prior to the beginning of each week of BPM31510 therapy.

arms: BPM31510, Vitamin K1, RT and TMZ

role_evidence.quote: After 2 wk of treatment with BPM31510 (ie, on Day 15), subjects will start concurrent TMZ 75 mg/m2 once daily (qd) × 42 days. Subjects will receive the standard TMZ treatment for up to 12 cycles post BPM31510 treatment.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent; standard Stupp chemoradiotherapy backbone
arms: BPM31510, Vitamin K1, RT and TMZ

coder_notes: Single-arm add-on of BPM31510 to standard RT/TMZ in newly diagnosed GBM. cns5_terminology historical because conditions list 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' and there is no IDH/WHO 2021 reference. BPM31510 is named only by development code; the CoQ10 link is inferred from the exclusion criterion (allergy to CoQ10), not stated as the identity. Vitamin K1 (registered as Other) is prophylactic supportive care. No stated antitumour mechanism, no biomarkers, no tumour PK or target engagement planned.
